definitions.explanation: A liquid solution used for cleaning or washing. Covers a wide range of products from contact lens solution to industrial cleaning fluids.

examples.japanese: コンタクトレンズの{洗浄液|せんじょうえき}を{買|か}う。
この{洗浄液|せんじょうえき}は{油|あぶら}{汚|よご}れに{効果的|こうかてき}だ。
examples.english: This cleaning solution is effective against grease stains.

examples.japanese: {機械|きかい}の{部品|ぶひん}を{専用|せんよう}の{洗浄液|せんじょうえき}に{浸|ひた}してから{組|く}み{立|た}てる。
examples.english: Soak the machine parts in a dedicated cleaning solution before assembling them.

notes:
A compound of {洗浄|せんじょう} (washing, cleansing) and {液|えき} (liquid). Used for any liquid cleaning product.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- コンタクトレンズ{洗浄液|せんじょうえき}: contact lens solution
- {洗浄液|せんじょうえき}で{洗|あら}う: to wash with cleaning solution
- {専用|せんよう}{洗浄液|せんじょうえき}: dedicated cleaning solution
- {洗浄液|せんじょうえき}を{補充|ほじゅう}する: to refill the cleaning solution

RELATED WORDS:
- {洗剤|せんざい}: detergent — a broader term for cleaning agents including powders
- {消毒液|しょうどくえき}: disinfectant solution — specifically for killing germs
